question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Pritilata was a student at Dr. Khastagir Government Girls' School in Chattogram. She also studied in Eden College, Dhaka. She graduated in philosophy with distinction from Bathune College in Kolkata. She had two dreams. The first one is a society without gender discrimination and the second one was to free her motherland from British colonial rule So she received combat training to fight against the British rule. After completing her education, she became the head teacher of Nandankanon Aparna Charan School in Chattogram. She was an activist in her college life. So, she involved herself in Surja Sen's armed resistance movement who was a famous anti-British movement organizer and activist in Chattogram area that time.
